# Subscription

A recurring subscription that needs to be cancelled, transferred, or maintained after death — streaming, utilities, memberships, software

Source: [`v3/subscription.json`](../../v3/subscription.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/subscription.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Unique identifier for this subscription |
| `serviceName` | `string` | yes | Name of the service |
| `cost` | [Money](common/money.md) | | Subscription cost per billing period |
| `billingFrequency` | one of `monthly`, `annual`, `other` | | How often the subscription is billed |
| `renewalDate` | `string` (date) | | Next renewal or billing date |
| `accountIdentifier` | `string` | | Account number, email, or username for this subscription |
| `cancelAction` | one of `cancel`, `transfer_to_person`, `maintain`, `unknown` | | What should happen to this subscription after death |
| `transferToPersonId` | `string` (uuid) | | Person.id to transfer the subscription to |
| `transferToPersonIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced transfer to person |
| `notes` | `string` | | Additional notes |
| `cancellationInfo` | `object` | | Information about how to cancel this subscription, particularly after a death. Complements the reference-data/subscription-cancellation-guide.json with per-subscription instance data |
| `provenance` | [Provenance](common/provenance.md) | | Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.
